{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicates = patient_counts[patient_counts > 1]

print(f"Number of patients with multiple entries: {len(duplicates)}")
print(f"Patients with duplicates: {list(duplicates.index)}")

# Check for sentinel value in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_count = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f"Number of rows with baseline biomarker = -999: {sentinel_count}")

# Check if any patient has both a -999 and a valid value
# If so, we must keep the valid one
has_valid_and_sentinel = df.groupby('patient_id')['biomarker_baseline'].apply(
    lambda x: (x == -999).any() and (x != -999).any()
)

print(f"Patients with both valid and sentinel baseline: {has_valid_and_sentinel[has_valid_and_sentinel].index.tolist()}")"}
